title: ShipSense
tagline: Parcel delivery ETA prediction & route optimization (real Olist data)
highlights: Layered Spring Boot API (controller/service/repository, JPA, global error handling).
Python ETL + scikit-learn pipeline on 96K real Olist orders predicting actual delivery days (4.9-day MAE, 8% over baseline).
Dijkstra route optimization over a real 27-state Brazilian border graph, with a React + TypeScript frontend, containerized with Docker.
